{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_completed_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue of real completed orders
mean_revenue = real_completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()

print(f'Number of real completed orders: {len(real_completed_orders)}')
print(f'Mean revenue of real completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
